stats.title: A real community, growing every week

why.title: Making friends as an adult is hard. It shouldn't be.
why.subtitle: Loneliness is rising everywhere — even in the busiest cities. APON makes the first step small, safe and regular.
why.card1Text: Moved for work or study and don't know anyone nearby yet? Meet people in your own neighbourhood.
why.card2Text: Jobs, marriage, moving abroad — old circles shrink. Build a new one around what you enjoy now.
why.card3Text: Likes and chats aren't friendship. APON is about sitting together over tea, a walk or a game.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three small steps, and then you are meeting real people.
how.step1Text: Pick your interests, where you live and the times you are usually free.
how.step2Text: Every week we form small circles of people who actually match — same area, same interests, overlapping time.
how.step3Text: Vote on the time, RSVP, and meet at an approved café, park or court near you.

week.title: A week in your circle
week.subtitle: Small, regular and low-pressure — the way real friendships grow.
week.day1Text: Meet your 4–6 people and say hello in the circle chat.
week.day2Text: Everyone votes on a time poll — the most popular slot wins.
week.day3Text: Confirm your spot. The exact venue appears once you're in.
week.day4Text: Coffee, a walk, a game — then share quick private feedback.

coverage.title: Built for all of Bangladesh
coverage.subtitle: From Dhaka's neighbourhoods to the smallest union — pick exactly where you live and we'll match you nearby.
coverage.footnote: {places} places: every division, district, upazila and union, plus all 12 city corporations with their thanas, wards and neighbourhoods.

safety.title: Safety is the product
safety.text: Friendship only works when people feel safe. Every part of APON is built around that.
safety.point1Text: Every account verifies its email, and a phone number is required before joining a circle or activity.
safety.point2Text: Venues stay private until you are confirmed for the meetup.
safety.point3Title: Report and block in one tap
safety.point3Text: Report anyone or anything. Blocked people never share a circle with you.
safety.point4Text: Every host application and every activity is reviewed by a real person.
safety.point5Text: Meetups happen at approved cafés, parks and courts — never private homes.
safety.point6Text: Your phone and email are never shown to other members.

host.title: Love bringing people together?
host.text: Hosts run small, friendly activities — a book club, a morning walk, a badminton session — and help newcomers feel welcome.
host.point1: Choose your own topic, time and approved venue
host.point2: Every activity is reviewed before it goes live
host.point3: Meet great people in your own area

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: A circle is 4–6 people near you — in your neighbourhood, thana or upazila — with overlapping interests and availability. You keep the same circle for weeks, so friendships have time to become real.
faq.a2: Joining APON is free. Some activities have a small cost (coffee, court rental) paid directly at the venue — always shown upfront.
faq.a3: All of Bangladesh: every division, district, upazila and union, plus all 12 city corporations down to thanas, wards and neighbourhoods like Gulshan, Dhanmondi, Agrabad or Zindabazar.
faq.q4: What if my circle is not a fit?
faq.a4: You can leave a circle at any time and request a new one. Nobody is stuck with anyone.
faq.a5: Yes. Turn on “women only” in your preferences and you will only be matched into women-only circles and activities.
faq.a6: Yes — apply to host from the Host page. A real person reviews every application.
faq.a7: Every Monday we group people in the same area by shared interests, overlapping free time, age range and language. People you've blocked are never matched with you.
faq.a8: No. APON is for friendship and community. Meetups are in groups, in public places, and our guidelines are enforced.
faq.more: Still curious? Read our community guidelines.

cta.title: Your weekly circle starts this week
cta.text: It takes about two minutes to set up your profile. The next matching run happens every Monday.

footer.note: APON is a community platform for meeting people in real life — not a dating app.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Before we go further, please read and accept these.
guidelines.rule1: Show up when you say you will, or cancel early.
guidelines.rule2: Treat everyone with respect — no harassment, no slurs, no romantic pressure.
guidelines.rule3: Keep what is shared in the circle inside the circle.
guidelines.rule4: Meet in public places. Alcohol and illegal activity are not welcome at APON meetups.
guidelines.rule5: Report anything that feels off. We read every report.
